en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a landscaped park with paths, a small bridge and dense vegetation. In the foreground stands a stone monument or memorial with pillars and a central block bearing a circular medallion or relief. A boy or young man in dark clothing and cap stands on the path to the right. In the background are several substantial houses or villas on a hillside, one with a tower and ornate roof. Printed red text at the top identifies the place and the park installations.
